title: Yeezus 2
description:
Tracklist seen in a photo of Kanye with his psychiatrist's kids, who played him their band THE CITIE's song "Snowflakes", as mentioned by Kanye on "No More Parties On LA". Was thought to be for So Help Me God based on the press release the photo is from referring to "Snowflakes" as THE CITIE's latest single, with it being released on April 3rd, 2015, however this is likely a re-release as the article is from January 22nd, and their YouTube was created June 17th, 2014. This tracklist is also missing key tracks such as "Enya", "Fade", and "Feedback", alongside "FourFiveSeconds" still being called "3", even though it was released by Rihanna on January 24th, 2015.

"TH" and "HO" are likely "Thirtyfivehunna" and "However You Want It" respectively, with Kanye possibly getting the idea to combine "However You Want It" with "All Day" after hearing them sequenced next to eachother. This tracklist shares a few track similarities with the April 29th copy of Yeezus 2, with a lot of the tracks on that copy which aren't seen on this tracklist being found on the "Possible Tracks" tracklist, further connecting all the tracklists together.

1. Nina Chop (Famous)
 2. God (Level)
3. Wo(lves)
 4. Th(irtyfivehunna) (3500)
5. Ho(wever You Want It)
6. All (Day)
 7. Only (One)
8. Sens- [Not enough text to guess]
9. Tell Yo(ur Friends) (When I See It)
10. 3 (FourFiveSeconds)

title: Yeezy BOOST 750
description: First seen during Kanye’s Yeezy Season 2 presentation at New York Fashion Week, the Yeezy Boost 750 ‘Chocolate’ sneaker was officially released a month later on October 15, 2016. The design combines a light brown nubuck upper with an elasticated mid-foot strap, perforated vamp, and a gum Boost midsole that glows in the dark. The sneaker also features an upgraded YKK ankle zipper.

title: YEEZY QUANTUM KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Kids ‘Amber Tint’ delivers a subdued colorway of the basketball-inspired silhouette. The upper combines grey semi-translucent mesh with a tonal suede toe cap and wavy synthetic overlays in a scattered blend of tan, bronze and black. The latter hue is repeated on the stretchy neoprene collar and tongue. A prominent heel counter wraps the back of the shoe and extends into the midsole, featuring full-length Boost cushioning wrapped in a TPU cage.

title: YEEZY 700 V3
description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Fade Carbon’ brings a unique gradient effect to the sleek lifestyle runner. Overlaid with a translucent RPU cage, the engineered mesh upper features a dull shade of violet that transitions to a bold magenta finish, with the vibrant hue seeping into the heel of the beige polyurethane midsole. Performance details include interior bootie construction for a snug, comfortable fit, and a herringbone-traction rubber outsole for optimal grip.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN LACELESS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Laceless ‘Analog’ presents a neutral colorway of the laceless lifestyle runner. The minimalist upper is composed of ivory polyester textile with contrasting black no-sew overlays and reflective silver ‘700’ branding on the lateral side. The sleek design is mounted on a sculpted PU midsole, featuring full-length drop-in Boost cushioning for a responsive ride. Underfoot, a herringbone-traction rubber outsole provides optimized grip.

title: POLAR FLEECE REGULAR FIT PANT (H10)
description:
Background: The YZY GAP Fleece Hoodie was initially planned for release in the Fall of 2022 as a part of the Holiday 2022 collection. Due to controversies surrounding Ye at the time, the collection was cancelled and first appeared in China on Gap's Toaboa Account on 10/27/2022, 2 days after Gap shut down yeezygap.com.

A Ye fanpage, @dondasglory, had seen this and tweeted about it, which caused Gap to take everything off Taobao. Gap would then wait a few months to release the collection on the Chinese App, Nice, through mystery boxes, and would begin slowly liquidating their stock to third parties.

These pants feature a vertical zipper at the base of the leg and are made from a puffy polar fleece fabric. 

Zip on the bottom of each leg is based on the Soft Tab Bottom Sweat Pant from Yeezy Season 1 Ye wore for the Diet Coke MV on 01/14/2022.

The Polar Fleece Regular Fit Pant did not release on yeezy.com.

(Retail Price may be inaccurate as it is converted from RMB prices on Chinese Gap tags)
